items.title: Peloton is revamping its treadmills with new features in the next phase of its turnaround
items.summary: With its new treadmills, Peloton aims to appeal to customers from casual workers to more serious athletes.
items.title_zh: Peloton 在转型新阶段升级跑步机并加入新功能
items.summary_zh: 凭借新款跑步机，Peloton 希望吸引从休闲健身者到更专业运动员的各类客户。

items.title: No new stock highs, no problem: Options traders bet they're coming in these names
items.summary: Options activity shows traders anticipate fresh highs are around the corner for a handful of names.
items.title_zh: 没有新高也不要紧：期权交易员押注这些个股即将创出新高
items.summary_zh: 期权活动显示，交易员预计少数个股即将创出新高。

items.title: Autonomous trucking company Aurora looks to accelerate toward profitability
items.summary: Aurora's founder and CEO told CNBC the company is targeting positive free cash flow by 2028, driven by a substantial increase in the number autonomous trucks.
items.title_zh: 自动驾驶卡车公司 Aurora 寻求加速实现盈利
items.summary_zh: Aurora 创始人兼首席执行官向 CNBC 表示，公司目标是在 2028 年前实现正自由现金流，驱动力来自自动驾驶卡车数量的显著增长。

items.title: Trump snaps at CNN at United Nations: 'You should not be here covering me'
items.summary: CNN, MS NOW and Politico are challenging Trump's ban of them from the White House with a lawsuit alleging he violated their First Amendment rights.
items.title_zh: 特朗普在联合国怒斥 CNN：你不该在这里报道我
items.summary_zh: CNN、MS NOW 和 Politico 正以诉讼挑战特朗普禁止其进入白宫的做法，指其侵犯了他们的第一修正案权利。

items.title: Circle lands $100 million from Binance to ramp up global USDC expansion
items.summary: Binance will invest $100 million in Circle and has agreed to promote the stablecoin issuer's flagship USDC on its platform.
items.title_zh: Circle 获币安 1 亿美元投资，加速 USDC 全球扩张
items.summary_zh: 币安将向 Circle 投资 1 亿美元，并同意在其平台上推广这家稳定币发行商的旗舰产品 USDC。

items.title: AMD's market value tops $1 trillion for the first time as the Meta agent boom ignites the CPU trade
items.summary: On Monday local time AMD closed up nearly 10%, with its market value surpassing $1 trillion for the first time, making it the fourth US chip company to cross that threshold after Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron
items.title_zh: AMD市值首破万亿美元！Meta智能体热潮点燃CPU行情
items.summary_zh: 当地时间周一，AMD收涨近10%，市值首次突破1万亿美元，成为继 英伟达 、 博通 和美光之后，第四家跨越这一门槛的美国芯片公司
